description: This file defines the Order class within the application core of an e-commerce project. It models an order entity, including properties for buyer ID, order date, shipping address, and associated order items. It includes constructor logic, encapsulation of order items, and a method to calculate the total order cost.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order with properties for buyer identification, shipping address, order date, and order items. It encapsulates order item collection to enforce domain rules and includes a method to compute total cost.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new order with buyer ID, shipping address, and order items, performing null or empty validation on buyer ID.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total cost of the order by summing the products of unit price and units for each order item.
